bug_semantics: LoopLimit is enforced only in TemplateContext.StepLoop() for script for/while statements. Built-in work such as 1..N (RangeInclude/ScriptRange yield) piped to array.size (IEnumerable.Cast<object>().Count()) and string*int (CalculateToString append loop) iterates or allocates without StepLoop, so LoopLimit=1 still allows {{ 1..1000000 | array.size }} and {{ 'A' * 200000000 }} DoS.
